name: alternating-stations-amrap
description: Alternating stations under one repeating AMRAP clock. Each station is a separately scored block: normalizeStationSections gives it a rounds-section of its own, so a movement inside it happens once per ROUND of that station and is counted per_round. It was per_station_visit while the stations lived as a flat movement list with nowhere to put a score — that mode divides the interval count among the stations, which is an estimate that ignores what the athlete did. stationIndices still pin that the stations stay distinct.
